summary: Iter19: Profile Settings (/settings), Game Store (/store + StoreAdmin), redesigned Profile with KOLEKSI KARTU, Home text/layout. Backend: new test_iter19_store_profile.py 18/18 pass (name update+validation, avatar upload→absolute URL served, 7-day cooldown 429, admin-only store CRUD 401/403, create/edit/soft-delete, redeem 200/402/410/409/404, balance decreases while xp/level unchanged, concurrent 5x double-tap → exactly one charge). Full regression -n 0: 318/327 first run; 8 leaderboard failures were caused by MY FE seed inserting a minimal best_scores doc (fixed seed, re-ran: all pass) and test_iter18 xp_empty_user needed new spent/balance keys (test updated). Frontend (390 & 360): home gear→/settings, all settings elements render, name change→'Profil berhasil disimpan!' and home shows new name, photo upload via picker works, cooldown msg 'Foto bisa diganti lagi pada …' shown, short-name validation; admin adds card with image + edits stock; /store shows card w/ TUKAR, redeem → balance 1.500→900, button DIMILIKI, stock 2→1, persists after reload; profile KOLEKSI KARTU shows owned card; profile gear→/settings. Home: TOURNAMENT one line, nav labels not clipped at 360/390, about text updated.

minor.issue: Returns 500 if any best_scores doc lacks name/category/correct/total/created_at (LeaderboardEntry(**doc) server.py:505). Real writes are complete, but one malformed doc takes down the whole leaderboard; consider skipping/defaulting invalid docs.
user_cards stores a snapshot of title/image_url; later admin edits of the card image/title are not reflected in users' KOLEKSI KARTU (may be intended).
custom_name/custom_picture preservation verified by code review only (server.py:267-274); cannot exercise real Google exchange in tests.

ui_bugs.issue: Price & stock TextInputs each render ~201px wide inside a flex row (flex:1 ignored on web due to intrinsic input width); Stok input overflows the card/screen (x=242,w=201 on 360px viewport). Add minWidth:0/width:0 with flex:1 or explicit widths.

integration_issues.issue: Values come from getLocalHigh() (device storage) not the server; logged-in user with server best_scores (1500) sees 0 on a new device/browser.
